title: Code and data for "Predicting the Trainability of Hardware-Efficient Variational Quantum Circuits: A Data-Driven Model for Barren Plateaus"

creators.name: Rahman, Md Habibur
creators.affiliation: Department of AI Convergence Engineering, Gyeongsang National University, Jinju, Republic of Korea

description:
Code, datasets and results for the revised manuscript Predicting the Trainability of Hardware-Efficient Variational Quantum Circuits: A Data-Driven Model for Barren Plateaus (submitted to Quantum Machine Intelligence).

Version 2 replaces the version-1 label. The label is now the log10 of the mean cost-gradient variance over all parameters, computed by adjoint differentiation, with parameters whose gradient vanishes identically detected and excluded. The version-1 file is kept for comparison.

Datasets (data_bp/):

  • bp_dataset_v2.csv: 20,000 hardware-efficient circuits with 2 to 12 qubits (main dataset)
  • bp_patterns_v2.csv: 10,000 circuits with brickwork and star entanglement, for the unseen-pattern test
  • bp_large_v2.csv: 2,000 held-out circuits with 13 and 14 qubits
  • bp_clifford_train.csv, bp_clifford_test.csv: 8,000 and 6,000 circuits with exact Clifford-sampled labels up to 32 qubits (the prediction-horizon benchmark)
  • bp_tied_v2.csv, bp_tied_large_v2.csv: 10,000 circuits with layer-shared parameters (2 to 12 qubits) and 1,000 held-out circuits with 13 and 14 qubits
  • bp_graph_v2.csv: 10,000 circuits with random entangling graphs
  • bp_dataset.csv: the version-1 dataset (single-parameter label)

Code: qsim/ (NumPy statevector simulator), qml_bp/ (circuit sampler, adjoint and Clifford-sampling gradient-variance estimators, dataset generators, all analyses). Results: paper/qmi/results/ holds the JSON files and tables behind every number in the manuscript; paper/qmi/ holds the manuscript source. The commands that regenerate everything, with fixed random seeds, are in qml_bp/README.md.
